name: Kasaragod
tagline: The Northern Citadel of Seven Tongues
description: Perched at Kerala's northern frontier, Kasaragod is a tranquil tapestry of majestic coastal forts, winding backwaters, coir-making hamlets, and rich multi-lingual heritage.
keyExperiences: Sunset walk on Bekal ramparts
Cruising untouched Valiyaparamba backwaters
Trekking the misty shola grasslands of Ranipuram
Witnessing rare Theyyam rituals in sacred groves
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Mangaluru International Airport (50 km). Major Railway Station: Kasaragod (KGQ).

name: Kannur
tagline: The Realm of Looms, Lore & Living Gods
description: Kannur pulses with ancient energy: from the mesmerizing sacred dance of Theyyam to Asia's longest drive-in beach at Muzhappilangad, colonial sea forts, and handloom traditions.
keyExperiences: Witnessing night-long Theyyam ceremonies in kavus
Driving along Muzhappilangad beach sands
Exploring the bastions of 1505 St. Angelo Fort
Hiking up to Paithalmala ridge
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Kannur International Airport (CNN). Major Railway Station: Kannur (CAN).

name: Wayanad
description: High on the Western Ghats plateau, Wayanad is an emerald paradise of cardamom plantations, bamboo forests, Neolithic cave petroglyphs, and untamed elephant corridors.
bestSeason: September to May (Monsoon: Jun-Aug for mist)
climate: Cool mountain climate, frequent hill mists
keyExperiences: Climbing through history at the prehistoric Edakkal rock engravings
Trek to Chembra heart-shaped lake
Bamboo rafting along the Kabini river at Kuruva Dweep
Jeep safari through misty forest corridors
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Calicut International Airport (95 km). Nearest Railway: Kozhikode (85 km). Scenic ghat road via Thamarassery Churam.

name: Kozhikode
tagline: The Capital of Spices & Malabar Soul
description: The historic port where spice trade with Arabs, Chinese, and Europeans forged legendary culinary artistry, literary intellect, warm hospitality, and historic shoreline piers.
keyExperiences: Sampling authentic Kozhikodan Halwa and Dum Biryani
Watching ancient wooden Uru ships crafted by hand in Beypore
Evening stroll past colonial iron pier ruins at Kozhikode beach
Trekking around the roaring cascades of Thusharagiri
foodSpecialties: Banana chips fried in coconut oil
howToReach: Calicut International Airport (CCJ) located 28 km away. Major Railway: Kozhikode (CLT).

name: Malappuram
tagline: Hill Terraces, Royal Teak & Cultural Renaissance
description: Framed by the Arabian Sea and Nilgiri foothills, Malappuram is renowned for the world's oldest teak plantation at Nilambur, sacred pilgrimage centres, and football passion.
keyExperiences: Walking through the world's oldest man-made teak plantation
Traditional Ayurveda treatments at legendary Kottakkal
Watching local Sevens football tournaments
Birdwatching at the Bharathapuzha river estuary
howToReach: Calicut International Airport (CCJ) is within 25 km. Major Railway: Tirur (TIR) and Angadippuram.

name: Palakkad
tagline: The Mountain Pass & Verdant Rice Fields
description: Guarding Kerala's primary mountain corridor through the Western Ghats, Palakkad is the state's rice bowl, replete with windswept palmyra trees, granite forts, and untouched rainforests.
keyExperiences: Experiencing the primeval quiet of Silent Valley evergreen rainforest
Exploring the 18th-century granite ramparts of Palakkad Fort
Driving winding hairpin bends into Nelliyampathy orange orchards
Attending the historic Kalpathy Ratholsavam chariot festival
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Coimbatore International (CJB, 55 km). Major Railway: Palakkad Junction (PGT).

name: Thrissur
description: Built spirally around a hillock crowned by the ancient Vadakkumnathan temple, Thrissur is Kerala's cultural beating heart, celebrated globally for the spectacle of Thrissur Pooram.
keyExperiences: Standing before the Niagara of India at Athirappilly Falls
Experiencing masterclasses in Kathakali & Mohiniyattam at Kalamandalam
Witnessing the thunderous Ilanjithara Melam percussion symphony
Sunset over the estuary at Chavakkad
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Cochin International Airport (COK, 53 km). Major Railway: Thrissur (TCR).

name: Ernakulam
tagline: The Commercial Hub & Colonial Harbor of Kochi
description: Where modern cosmopolitan flair meets spice warehouses, Chinese fishing nets, 500-year-old Portuguese synagogues, cutting-edge art biennales, and vibrant island ferries.
keyExperiences: Bicycle tour through colonial lanes of Fort Kochi
Sunset ferry ride past cantilevered Chinese fishing nets
Kayaking through the serene prawn farms of Kadamakudy
Discovering contemporary art galleries in heritage godowns
howToReach: Cochin International Airport (COK) inside the district. Major Railway: Ernakulam Junction (ERS) & Town (ERN).

name: Idukki
tagline: The Highland Kingdom of Mist & Spices
description: Dominated by towering peaks of the Western Ghats, sprawling tea gardens, wildlife sanctuaries, and Asia's first arch dam, Idukki is a breath of crisp mountain air.
keyExperiences: Walking through endless carpeted green tea slopes in Munnar
Spotting endangered Nilgiri Tahr on Anamudi slopes
Bamboo rafting in Periyar Tiger Reserve
Paragliding over Vagamon green meadows
foodSpecialties: Tapioca with spicy Kanthari Fish Curry
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Cochin International (110 km). Nearest Railway: Aluva (105 km) or Kottayam (115 km).

name: Kottayam
tagline: The Land of Letters, Lakes & Rubber Groves
description: Nestled between the Western Ghats and Vembanad Lake, Kottayam is the historic hub of Malayalam publishing, Syrian Christian cuisine, rubber plantations, and backwater bird havens.
keyExperiences: Birdwatching at Kumarakom sanctuary during migratory winter
Canoeing through quiet village waterways of Aymanam
Climbing up to the knife-edge cliff of Illikkal Kallu
Relishing Syrian Christian duck roast and toddy shop delicacies
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Cochin International (85 km). Major Railway: Kottayam (KTYM).

name: Alappuzha
tagline: The Venice of the East & Backwater Capital
description: An intricate maze of shimmering canals, endless paddy fields cultivated below sea level in Kuttanad, thatched houseboats, coir weaving, and the historic Alappuzha lighthouse.
keyExperiences: Overnight cruise on a luxury eco-kettuvallam houseboat
Gliding on a silent wooden canoe through village canals
Witnessing the roaring Nehru Trophy Snake Boat Race
Unwinding on the pristine white sands of Marari
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Cochin International (78 km). Major Railway: Alappuzha (ALLP).

name: Pathanamthitta
tagline: The Pilgrim Capital & Sacred Forest Hills
description: The spiritual heartland of Kerala, bordered by dense forest reserves, sacred hill temples like Sabarimala, the mirror craft of Aranmula, and holy rivers Pamba and Achankovil.
keyExperiences: Watching master craftsmen cast authentic Aranmula Kannadi metal mirrors
Deep forest safari and camping at misty Gavi
Seeing trained timber elephants at Konni training kraal
Attending the Aranmula Boat Race and grand Valla Sadya feast
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Trivandrum International (105 km) or Cochin (140 km). Nearest Railway: Chengannur (CNGR, 26 km) or Thiruvalla.

name: Kollam
tagline: The Cashew Capital & Gateway to Ashtamudi
description: An ancient international seaport on the shores of eight-armed Ashtamudi Lake, known for cashew processing, red-and-white Tangasseri lighthouse, and coastal boat cruises to Alappuzha.
topDestinations: Jatayu Earth's Center (World's Largest Bird Sculpture)
keyExperiences: Canoe tour along the narrow mangrove waterways of Munroe Island
Taking the cable car to Jatayu Earth's Center sculpture
Climbing 144 steps of Tangasseri Lighthouse for panoramic sea views
Boarding the legendary 8-hour DTPC ferry cruise to Alappuzha
howToReach: Nearest Airport: Trivandrum International (65 km). Major Railway: Kollam Junction (QLN).

name: Thiruvananthapuram
tagline: The Regal Capital of Cliffs, Cove & Castles
description: The stately capital city where the wealth and sanctity of Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple blend with the dramatic red laterite cliffs of Varkala, Kovalam crescent beaches, and Ponmudi hills.
keyExperiences: Watching dramatic Arabian sunsets from atop the Varkala cliff cafes
Exploring the Dravidian stone architecture of Padmanabhaswamy Temple
Scenic morning drive up the 22 hairpin bends of Ponmudi hill station
Ayurvedic wellness massage in Kovalam
howToReach: Trivandrum International Airport (TRV) in city center. Major Railway: Thiruvananthapuram Central (TVC).
